findings.evidence: Mathlib names such lemmas without `setOf`: `measurableSet_tendsto` for `{x | Tendsto …}` (mathlib/Mathlib/MeasureTheory/MeasurableSpace/MeasurablyGenerated.lean:143), `measurableSet_mem : MeasurableSet {s : Set α | a ∈ s}` (MeasurableSpace/Constructions.lean:957), `measurableSet_eq : MeasurableSet {x | x = a}` (MeasurableSpace/Defs.lean:256). `measurableSet_setOf` is itself deprecated upstream in favour of `measurableSet_setOfPred` (MeasurableSpace/Constructions.lean:876); grep finds no `measurableSet_setOf_*` name in Mathlib.
findings.fix: Rename to `measurableSet_strictMono` (updating the single use at line 236).
findings.issue: `measurableSet_setOf_strictMono` carries a `setOf` component Mathlib does not use in set-of-predicate measurability names; the Mathlib-shaped name is `measurableSet_strictMono` (the naming doc also lists `_strictMono` as the suffix for `StrictMono f`).

findings.evidence: Lines 249-251 vs 263-266; Mathlib's precedent for the dot-notation form is `Continuous.integrableOn_Icc (hf : Continuous f) : IntegrableOn f (Icc a b) μ` (mathlib/Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Function/LocallyIntegrable.lean:600).
findings.fix: Name both the same way: either `Continuous.integrableOn_orderedRegion_prod` next to `Continuous.integrableOn_orderedRegion` (dot notation on the `Continuous` hypothesis, matching Mathlib's `Continuous.integrableOn_Icc`), or move both into `EpsilonEridani.OrderedSimplex` as `integrableOn_orderedRegion`/`integrableOn_orderedRegion_prod`, which also removes the namespace close/reopen at lines 243-257.
findings.issue: `integrableOn_orderedRegion_prod` (line 263, in `EpsilonEridani.OrderedSimplex`) and `Continuous.integrableOn_orderedRegion` (line 249, root `Continuous` namespace) have the same shape — first explicit argument `Continuous _`, conclusion `IntegrableOn _ (orderedRegion …)` — yet are filed in different namespaces under different name patterns, so only one is reachable by `hf.`-completion and the pair reads as unrelated API.

summary: Names describe conclusions in the roadmap's own terminology and no notation is added, but one general measurability lemma uses a name component (`setOf`) that Mathlib does not use in such names, and the two ordered-region integrability lemmas of identical shape are split across two namespaces with inconsistent naming.
